name: Dell Technologies Technical Customer Support Specialist
description: Five-course professional certificate developed by Dell Technologies on Coursera. Prepares learners for technical customer support and IT help desk roles by covering computer hardware architecture and diagnostics, operating system and software troubleshooting, networking and cybersecurity fundamentals, omnichannel customer service communication, active listening, conflict de-escalation, and technical incident management.

criteria.narrative: Completed all five courses in the Dell Technologies Technical Customer Support Specialist Professional Certificate on Coursera: (1) Dell Technologies Technical Support Career Introduction, (2) Dell Technologies Technical Support for Hardware, (3) Dell Technologies Technical Support for Software, (4) Dell Technologies Networking & Security Technical Support, and (5) Dell Technologies Customer Service for Technical Support.
